value.title: PRD 002: triage pij's earlier register into a fresh PRD
value.summary: Roadmap 001 step s14, req-25, as ruling C15 recast it. The earlier register stays archived in the private repo and is never copied here. docs-system checks its open rows against today's code and writes the ones still true, in new words, into docs/project/prds/002-pij-base.dd.json under pij/prd. AGENTS.md and the pij skill then point at PRD 002.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Planning found (2026-11-04): pij-fleet has no prd/ folder under its government root; AGENTS.md's Governance section points at <government-root>/prd/base-prd.dd.json, which does not exist here. The earlier register lives in a private repo, frozen at commit e05661c8 (2026-09-07): schema prd/requirements, 54 rows, of which 40 are open (36 unchecked, 4 open) and 14 are done (10 checked, 4 shipped). pij-fleet is public, and the rows cite private PRs, machine paths and other projects. Ruling C15: leave the register where it is; triage the open rows into a fresh PRD 002 in new words with no private references. C11 and C12 still govern state, priority and done_when for the rows kept. PRD number 002 is claimed for this plan by pm-001.

sections.name: goals
value: pij's live requirements are in docs/project/prds/002-pij-base.dd.json under pij/prd, beside PRD 001.
Every open row of the earlier register gets one verdict against today's code: kept and rewritten into PRD 002, or dropped with a reason.
Nothing private, and no copied text, reaches the public repo.
AGENTS.md and the pij skill point at PRD 002, not at a path that does not exist here.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Copying, converting or publishing the earlier register, its done rows or its wording (C15).
Editing the private repo or adding a pointer there.
New requirements the earlier register did not have; those go through the PRD procedure (s13).

value.claim: Frozen source. The triage reads the register only at commit e05661c8, with `git show` in a read-only checkout of the private repo, and records the sha. No file and no quoted text from that repo enters pij-fleet.
value.receipt: Read only with git show at e05661c8 in the read-only private checkout; check.py takes the sha; no source file or text in this repo (copy check 0)

value.claim: Triage. Each of the 40 open rows gets exactly one verdict in assets/evidence/triage.md: its old id, kept (with its PRD 002 id) or dropped, and a one-line reason in new words that names today's code (a file or a verb) where the code decides it. A row today's code already meets is dropped as met. A row whose verdict is unclear goes to pm-001 as a question, not a guess.
value.receipt: assets/evidence/triage.md: 40/40 verdicts (14 kept, 21 dropped-met, 5 dropped-unwanted), each reason naming code or tests; revised after the b13f5b3 review; req-0020 kept as could by ruling C17

value.claim: PRD 002. Kept rows are written fresh as pij/prd requirements with new ids, a statement in new words, a testable done_when, priority `should` unless the need is a must (C12), and state planned, or in-progress where live work is named (C11). Its why, actors and goals describe pij as it is today. No statement or note reuses the source's wording. `ddocs validate docs/project/prds/002-pij-base.dd.json` is clean.
value.receipt: docs/project/prds/002-pij-base.dd.json: 13 rows, each note naming the code that leaves it open; ddocs validate ok 0/0; copy check 0 shared 8-word runs

value.claim: Publication. PRD 002 and the triage record hold no private PR numbers, machine paths, credentials, transcript text, or references to other repositories or projects. The scan and the copy check (bp-0002) are clean, and the security verdict passes on the exact head.
value.note: Scrub and copy check clean (assets/evidence/scrub.txt); security verdict on the exact head pending

value.claim: Pointers. AGENTS.md's Governance section and skills/pij/references/prime/rituals/bootstrap.md point at docs/project/prds/002-pij-base.dd.json, and no file in pij-fleet still points at a register path that does not exist here.
value.receipt: AGENTS.md Governance and bootstrap.md point at PRD 002; grep prd/base-prd in AGENTS.md, skills/, harness/ finds none

value.claim: States. In this PR: roadmap s14 goes to shipped with its plan cell set to docs/plans/192-prd-register-move; req-25 goes to shipped. req-25 and s14 already carry C15's wording (pm-001, on this branch). PRD 001, roadmap 001 and PRD 002 validate clean.
value.receipt: s14 complete (roadmap enum has no shipped) with plan cell; req-25 shipped; PRD 001, roadmap 001, PRD 002 ok 0/0

value.title: Triage the open rows into PRD 002
value.brief: AC1 to AC6. docs-system, after s02 phase 1. CS-3: 40 rows read against today's code; the kept rows written fresh.

value.question: Ruling: may the earlier, private register be published, scrubbed, in public pij-fleet? Options: (a) move all 54 rows, scrubbed, with private references reduced to commit shas; (b) move only the 40 rows still open, with a note that shipped history stays private; (c) do not move it, and amend req-25. Recommended: (a). Needs Jordan.
value.answer: Ruled C15 (Jordan: leave it): none of (a) to (c). The register stays archived in the private repo; its open rows are triaged into a fresh PRD 002 in new words. The plan was rewritten to match.

value.question: State mapping into planned, in-progress, shipped, dropped. Recommended: checked and shipped to shipped; unchecked and open to planned, or in-progress where the row's note names live work.
value.answer: Ruled C11. For the kept rows: planned, or in-progress where the row names live work.

value.question: done_when and priority for rows that lack them. Recommended: shipped rows use their receipt rule as done_when; other rows get the requirement's own testable clause, or 'to be written' in note; priority 'should' unless the row says must.
value.answer: Ruled C12. done_when is the kept row's own testable clause, or 'to be written' in note; priority `should` unless it is a must.

value.risk: Private content or copied wording published in a public repo.
value.mitigation: C15: fresh words only; scrub scan and copy check (bp-0002); security verdict on the exact head.

value.risk: The triage turns into a redesign of pij's requirements.
value.mitigation: Keep each kept row to the need it states; unclear verdicts go to pm-001 as questions (AC2).

value.risk: The legacy register changes during the triage.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Read the source only with `git show e05661c8:<path>` in the read-only legacy checkout; never write there, never copy its files or text into pij-fleet (C15).
Starts after s02 phase 1 lands; the same docs-system seat does that first.
